name: io.github.antohins/seo-tools-mcp-aparser
title: SEO Tools: A-Parser bridge
description: Drive a self-hosted A-Parser instance: SERP, suggests and hundreds of parsers via its API (read-only).

environmentVariables.name: APARSER_URL
environmentVariables.description: A-Parser API endpoint, e.g. http://IP:9091/API (Settings -> API).

environmentVariables.name: APARSER_GOOGLE_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Default config preset for SE::Google (preset name from the GUI).

environmentVariables.name: APARSER_YANDEX_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Default config preset for SE::Yandex (preset name from the GUI).

environmentVariables.name: APARSER_USE_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Use proxies by default (true/false; default true).
